name: Papich M200 Pack
description:
A pack of M-sized classic templates. The template variants are marked as A, B etc. on the template list in the game.

Recommended settings:

Size: M
Players: 2
Monsters: strong
Roads: all types
Water: none
Difficulty: 200%
Simultaneous turns: 113
Timer: 4-3-1:30
Restarts: 2x111/1x112
author: wnukos
